issue_description: The student toilet is completely blocked and water sanitation pipelines are leaking, making the facility unusable.
There is no drinking water filter or working borewell connection. Students are bringing water from home or drinking untreated water.
Only one teacher is present for classes 1 to 5. The other three staff members are absent or on long-term transfer.
The classroom building roof is leaking heavily during rain, leading to water accumulation and wall dampness.
The classroom fan and tube light wiring has caught fire. There is currently no electricity in the entire secondary wing.
A large crack has formed on the classroom wall and the structural plaster is falling down, creating an unsafe environment for children.
Classroom benches and desks are completely broken. Many students have to sit on the cold floor to study.
Repeated sanitation issue: the septic tank is overflowing into the playground, creating a major health hazard.
